data.title: Reading Slope Triangles
data.description: Practice finding the slope of various lines by reading the rise and run directly from pre-drawn slope triangles on the coordinate grid.

challenges.instruction: Look at the triangle on the line. Count the rise (vertical) and run (horizontal).
challenges.hint: Start at the lower corner of the triangle. Count grid squares vertically to the opposite corner — that's the rise (positive if you went up, negative if you went down). Then count grid squares horizontally to the other corner — that's the run.
